decision.reason: Primary19 and allknown23 candidate coverage deteriorated overall; VidSTG has zero new positive pool advantage. Two HC positives do not justify GT-selected case or window continuation.

candidate_rules.box: exact connected-component pixel envelope normalized by cached frame width and height; never clamp a geometry later
candidate_rules.eligible_track: center component plus at least one accepted adjacent match on each side of center
candidate_rules.identity_scope: one five-frame window only; no identity claim across windows
candidate_rules.overflow: preserve every eligible track beyond four in metadata; only first four receive visible candidate IDs
candidate_rules.source_policy: copy only the existing Source candidate-1 five-frame tracklet exactly

component_matching.assignment: mutual nearest positive edge, exact ties broken by component row-major (top,left,bottom,right,id)
component_matching.directional_warp: forward splat source masks with forward flow and destination masks with backward flow; nearest-pixel splat
component_matching.edge_rule: both directional warped-mask IoUs must be strictly greater than zero
component_matching.edge_score: minimum of forward and backward warped-mask IoU; diagnostic only and not used to select directional nearest neighbors
component_matching.missing_transition: no match and no track bridging across it
component_matching.nearest_rule: source nearest uses forward warped IoU; target reverse-nearest uses backward warped IoU; accept only reciprocal choices with both IoUs strictly positive

dense_flow.mask_note: The pre-morphology residual mask requires cycle-valid pixels. The fixed opening/closing operation may remove or fill pixels afterward; component pixels are not individually asserted to pass the pre-morphology cycle test.

generator_config.frame_mask_rule: For each non-final frame use the cleaned forward residual mask from its outgoing adjacent transition. For the final frame use the cleaned backward residual mask from the incoming final transition.

scene_motion.fallback: none; invalid affine makes the transition unavailable
scene_motion.seed: first four SHA256 bytes of case/slot/physical transition binding, masked to signed 31-bit positive integer

interpretation_limit: Center-frame candidate-pool oracle diagnostic only; it is not an online selector, full-tube efficacy result, or semantic identity metric.

postseal_evaluation.scope: postseal center geometry comparison; not semantic identity or full tube efficacy
